parameters.name: Ciphersuite
parameters.description: The custom cipher suite to use when `CiphersuiteGroup` is set to `custom`.

parameters.name: CiphersuiteGroup
parameters.description:
The cipher suite group. Default value: `all`. Valid values:

- `all`: All cipher suites.

- `strict`: strong cipher suites.

- `custom`: custom cipher suites.

parameters.name: Http2
parameters.description:
Indicates whether HTTP/2 is enabled. Default value: `on`. Valid values:

- `on`: Enabled.

- `off`: Disabled.

parameters.name: Http3
parameters.description:
Indicates whether HTTP/3 is enabled. Default value: `on`. Valid values:

- `on`: Enabled.

- `off`: Disabled.

parameters.name: Https
parameters.description:
Indicates whether HTTPS is enabled. Default value: `on`. Valid values:

- `on`: Enabled.

- `off`: Disabled.

parameters.name: OcspStapling
parameters.description:
Indicates whether OCSP stapling is enabled. Default value: `off`. Valid values:

- `on`: Enabled.

- `off`: Disabled.

parameters.name: Rule
parameters.description:
The conditional expression used to match incoming requests. This parameter is not required when you add a global configuration. Use cases:

- To match all incoming requests, set the value to `true`.

- To match specific requests, set the value to a custom expression, for example, `(http.host eq "video.example.com")`.

parameters.name: RuleEnable
parameters.description:
Indicates whether the rule is enabled. This parameter is not required when you add a global configuration. Valid values:

- `on`: Enabled.

- `off`: Disabled.

parameters.name: RuleName
parameters.description: The rule name. This parameter is not required when you add a global configuration.

parameters.name: Sequence
parameters.description: The rule execution order. A smaller value indicates a higher priority.

parameters.name: SiteId
parameters.description: The site ID. You can call the [ListSites](~~ListSites~~) operation to obtain the site ID.

parameters.name: Tls10
parameters.description:
Indicates whether TLS 1.0 is enabled. Default value: `off`. Valid values:

- `on`: Enabled.

- `off`: Disabled.

parameters.name: Tls11
parameters.description:
Indicates whether TLS 1.1 is enabled. Default value: `off`. Valid values:

- `on`: Enabled.

- `off`: Disabled.

parameters.name: Tls12
parameters.description:
Indicates whether TLS 1.2 is enabled. Default value: `off`. Valid values:

- `on`: Enabled.

- `off`: Disabled.

parameters.name: Tls13
parameters.description:
Indicates whether TLS 1.3 is enabled. Default value: `off`. Valid values:

- `on`: Enabled.

- `off`: Disabled.
